Assumptions: Exact nominal model; ideal command execution; Kmis=1
SignalScope: Noise is simulated additive Gaussian feedback perturbation; not measured interaction forces
NoiseOnlyScope: Noise-only zero probability assumes true input is identically zero
MatchedStateScope: Matched-state noise difference is an offline diagnostic, not closed-loop transfer
Aggregation: ThreeJointMean is unweighted mean of jointwise metrics within each trial
PublicationCondition: 100 trials required for paper claim; smaller counts are smoke tests only
